provided.name: WfmImportReader
provided.rule: RETIRED Task Nos are immutable nonreuse authority: they are never treated as ABSENT and cannot become create/adopt targets. source_acceptance_base_token is SHA-256 over LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json UTF-8 bytes for the exact closed SOMA_WFM_IMPORT_BASE_V1 object selected by target.proposal_kind. target is exactly {proposal_kind,task_no,task_id|null}. For wfm_create_or_adopt the payload is {schema,proposal_kind,task_no,task_no_status,identity} where identity is null for ABSENT or {task_id,current_rfc_id,assignment_revision} for ACTIVE; RETIRED never produces an acceptable token/proposal. For wfm_source_projection the payload is {schema,proposal_kind,task_no,task_no_status,identity,source_projection}, task_no_status must be ACTIVE, identity is {task_id,current_rfc_id,assignment_revision}, and source_projection is null when absent or the exact current {source_projection_revision,provider_status_token,provider_lifecycle_class,source_plan_start_utc,source_plan_end_utc,accepted_source_observation_id,source_base_token}. Local Task revision, operational plan, execution, Objective membership and locks are deliberately excluded from wfm_source_projection freshness so independent local work cannot suppress newer provider evidence. For wfm_plan_reconciliation the payload is {schema,proposal_kind,task_no,task_no_status,identity,task_revision,source_projection,operational_plan,execution,objective_plan_context,lock}; source_projection must be current and nonnull; operational_plan is null when task_plan_current is absent or exact {plan_revision_id,revision,start_utc,end_utc,origin,source_observation_id}; execution is the exact current LLD-05 execution freshness authority; objective_plan_context is null when ungrouped or the exact current membership/objective plan-lock context used by SetTaskPlan; lock is the exact current Task lock projection including explicit plan/membership flags and its revision/history tip. Any owner-authority disagreement or unreconcilable projection/history fails closed rather than hashing guessed state. The digest never contains LLD-04 proposal ids, source row order, UI state or wall clock.

provided.name: WfmImportMutationService
provided.rule: All methods require the caller-owned outer command receipt to exist and revalidate the corresponding SOMA_WFM_IMPORT_BASE_V1 authority before writing. create_or_adopt_wfm_from_source consumes only a reviewed wfm_create_or_adopt binding: exact task_no, exact source-observation canonical_parent_rfc_no resolved by LLD-04/03 to current_rfc_id, exact source lifecycle classification used only for eligibility, and exact ACTIVE-existing task_id or ABSENT state; it creates/adopts identity and assignment only and never accepts source projection, operational plan, execution, outcome or Objective membership. apply_wfm_source_projection consumes only a reviewed wfm_source_projection binding for one existing exact WFM Task plus the accepted immutable source_observation_id and a closed source projection derived from that same observation: provider_status_token/provider_lifecycle_class and source plan. It may advance accepted_source_observation_id while preserving prior recognized lifecycle when current task_status evidence is blank/unknown/malformed; a complete source plan requires both validated endpoints, both validated blank endpoints represent unscheduled provider source plan, and a partial/malformed pair cannot clear prior plan truth. This mutation changes no Task execution/outcome/Objective membership/operational plan. Entering Complete or Plan Cancel creates/supersedes the separately reviewed source-terminal consequence authority under the same UoW when local consequence review is required. apply_reviewed_operational_plan_from_source consumes only wfm_plan_reconciliation whose current accepted source projection is the exact reviewed observation/revision and has a complete nonnull source plan; it revalidates task revision/current plan/execution/objective-plan context/locks, appends one task_plan_revision origin=wfm_source_adoption with that exact source_observation_id, advances task_plan_current and Task revision once, preserves any Objective membership plan pin/envelope, and surfaces mismatch/regroup input separately. Beta 1.0 has no destructive operational-plan clear: an unscheduled provider source plan is valid source evidence but cannot generate or accept wfm_plan_reconciliation that removes an existing operational plan.

provided.name: RfcTerminalTaskParticipant
provided.rule: Preview owns the complete Task/Objective impact calculation and provider fingerprint. Hard-delete classify is read-only, uses one shared predicate for stable snapshot and current writer read contexts, and never mutates/commits. Revalidate uses the caller LLD-03 writer UnitOfWork, recomputes that same complete current impact authority, exact-compares reviewed count/fingerprint, returns no impact rows and mutates nothing. Apply uses the same caller UnitOfWork only after LLD-03 has both provider revalidations READY, deliberate proof has been consumed and the outer command receipt exists. Apply records all exact Task/Objective consequence/history/audit rows under command_context.command_id, never commits independently, and returns one bounded RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1 whose result_fingerprint binds the complete ordered provider-owned result/audit identities without exporting that unbounded set to LLD-03.

provided.name: RfcHistoryRiskProvider
provided.rule: Read-only and determinate for either one stable LLD-01 Snapshot or the current supplied UnitOfWork read context. READY returns risk LOW|HIGH, the exact count of complete current risk-evidence entries and a lowercase SHA-256 provider_fingerprint. INDETERMINATE returns no risk/count/fingerprint and a bounded warning code and fails closed. HIGH iff an affected Task has accepted plan, Objective membership, execution, retry, outcome, source adoption or other protected Task history. provider_fingerprint is SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_HISTORY_AUTHORITY_V1 over the complete current ordered risk-evidence authority for rfc_id; evidence entries are closed tuples {task_id,family,evidence_id,revision|null}, ordered by task_id UTF-8 then family then evidence_id. Closed families are wfm_assignment,wfm_source,task_plan,objective_membership,task_execution,task_retry,task_outcome,task_relationship,task_activity_lineage,task_operational_count,task_lock. Immutable history rows use their immutable row identity with revision null; mutable current/projection authority uses its owning task_id as evidence_id plus current revision. Canonicalize the exact closed object {schema:'SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_HISTORY_AUTHORITY_V1',rfc_id,risk,evidence:[...]} using LLD-01 StrictVersionedJson canonical_json and hash its exact UTF-8 bytes. The provider may stream the ordered rows to an identical canonical byte sequence and must not materialize an unbounded transport collection. Any relevant evidence append, removal forbidden by history policy, current/projection revision change, or affected evidence membership change changes provider_fingerprint even when risk and exact count remain unchanged.

provided.name: TaskSiteDependencyValidator
provided.rule: Read-only validation; authoritative guard uses caller UnitOfWork and fails closed.

rules: Task lifecycle remains LLD-05 authority; cross-domain consumers cannot infer execution from plans or provider source state.
Objective state remains derived from Task facts; starting an Objective never creates Task execution evidence by itself.

RFC terminal-cascade writer revalidation and apply share the caller LLD-03 UnitOfWork; neither creates a receipt, commit or rollback, and revalidation must precede deliberate-proof consumption and apply.

RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionCommandContextV1 is provenance only: it carries the already-owned outer command/actor/review binding and no proof/session secret; Task/Objective business guards remain LLD-05 authority.

There is no terminal-cascade consequence-count business maximum. Exact Task/Objective rows remain row-wise LLD-05 authority; the bounded participant apply summary is only cross-packet correlation evidence.
RFC hard-delete classification is read-only and accepts stable snapshot or current writer read context; both use the exact same LLD-05 dependency predicate.

RFC hierarchy history review freshness is provider-owned: LLD-03 receives only bounded RfcHierarchyHistoryAuthorityV1 and never copies Task/WFM/Objective rows. Preview and writer revalidation call the same authority algorithm against their respective reader, so a same-classification history change cannot reuse an older hierarchy correction review.
Retired WFM Task Nos remain LLD-05 authority after eligible hard delete and are surfaced only as bounded ACTIVE|RETIRED|ABSENT classification; no retired identity row crosses into LLD-04.
